name: Bank Account Opening
place: A branch office of a major bank
role: You are a bank customer service manager.
speaker: Banker

tasks.goal: Greet the banker and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the banker and stated purpose.

Japanese.goal: 銀行員にあいさつして用件を伝える
Japanese.hint: 着いたら、まず用件をはっきり伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: State your desire to open a checking account
tasks.hint: Inform the banker what type of account you need.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested to open a checking account.

Japanese.goal: 普通預金口座を開きたいと伝える
Japanese.hint: どんな種類の口座が必要か、銀行員に伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about minimum opening deposit and monthly maintenance fees
tasks.hint: Inquire about initial funds required and recurring fees.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about minimum deposit and monthly fees.

Japanese.goal: 口座開設に必要な最低預入額と毎月の口座維持手数料について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 最初に必要なお金と、毎月かかる手数料を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if online banking and mobile app access are included
tasks.hint: Inquire about digital account features and app setup.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about online banking access.
tasks.scene_hint: A silent digital ticker displays currency exchange rates near teller stations.

Japanese.goal: ネットバンキングとスマホアプリが使えるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 口座のオンライン機能とアプリの設定について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about interest rates on high-yield savings add-ons
tasks.hint: Ask if linking a savings account earns interest.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about savings account interest rates.

Japanese.goal: 追加できる高金利の貯蓄預金の金利について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 貯蓄預金口座をつなげると利息がつくか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'statement'
tasks.hint: Statement is a summary of bank transactions. Ask if paper statements are mailed.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'statement'.

Japanese.goal: 「明細」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 明細は、口座のお金の出入りをまとめたものです。紙の明細が郵送されるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about international wire transfer fees and currency conversion
tasks.hint: Inquire how much sending money abroad costs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about international wire transfer fees.

Japanese.goal: 海外送金の手数料と通貨の両替について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 海外にお金を送るのにいくらかかるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate fee waiver conditions by setting up direct deposit
tasks.hint: Ask if recurring payroll deposits waive monthly charges.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated fee waivers using direct deposit.

Japanese.goal: 給与振込を設定することで手数料を免除してもらえるよう交渉する
Japanese.hint: 毎月の給与振込があれば、月々の手数料が無料になるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about overdraft protection policies and fee caps
tasks.hint: Inquire what happens if your balance drops below zero.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about overdraft protection policy.

Japanese.goal: 残高不足のときの貸越サービスの規定と手数料の上限について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 残高がマイナスになったらどうなるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Address an issue with proof of address documentation
tasks.hint: Provide an alternative utility bill when requested by the banker.
tasks.done_when: Learner resolved address documentation verification.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft pen clicks echo across polished mahogany desk surfaces.

Japanese.goal: 住所を証明する書類の問題に対応する
Japanese.hint: 銀行員に求められたら、代わりに公共料金の請求書を出しましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask how long it takes to receive a physical debit card
tasks.hint: Inquire about card delivery timeline by mail.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about debit card delivery timeframe.

Japanese.goal: デビットカードが届くまでどのくらいかかるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: カードが郵送で届くまでの日数を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm identity verification requirements and SSN or passport check
tasks.hint: Ask which official ID documents are mandatory.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified required identification documents.

Japanese.goal: 本人確認に必要なもの（社会保障番号やパスポートの確認）を確認する
Japanese.hint: どの公的な身分証明書が必ず必要か聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Set up initial security PIN and debit card security limits
tasks.hint: Select security parameters for your debit card.
tasks.done_when: Learner set up debit card PIN and security limits.

Japanese.goal: 暗証番号とデビットカードの利用限度額を設定する
Japanese.hint: デビットカードのセキュリティ設定を選びましょう。

tasks.goal: Request a printed account summary and routing number document
tasks.hint: Ask for official paperwork containing routing and account numbers.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed account numbers and summary.

Japanese.goal: 口座の概要とルーティング番号（金融機関コード）が書かれた書類を印刷してもらう
Japanese.hint: 金融機関コードと口座番号が書かれた正式な書類をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Thank the banker and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the banker AND said goodbye.

Japanese.goal: 銀行員にお礼を言って別れのあいさつをする
Japanese.hint: 感謝の気持ちを伝えて、会話を終えましょう。

tasks.goal: State preference for checking or high-yield savings account
tasks.hint: Clarify account type desired when sitting with banker.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated preference for checking or savings account type.

Japanese.goal: 普通預金口座と高金利の貯蓄預金口座のどちらがいいか伝える
Japanese.hint: 銀行員と話すときに、希望する口座の種類をはっきり伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Provide valid government photo identification and passport
tasks.hint: Present ID documents required for identity verification.
tasks.done_when: Learner provided government photo ID for account opening.

Japanese.goal: 有効な写真付きの公的身分証明書とパスポートを提示する
Japanese.hint: 本人確認に必要な身分証明書を出しましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about minimum initial deposit requirements
tasks.hint: Ask how much money is required to activate new account.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about minimum initial opening deposit.

Japanese.goal: 最初に必要な最低預入額について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 新しい口座を使い始めるのにいくら必要か聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm debit card mailing address and delivery timeline
tasks.hint: Ask how many business days until debit card arrives by mail.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified debit card delivery address and timeline.

Japanese.goal: デビットカードの送付先住所と届くまでの日数を確認する
Japanese.hint: デビットカードが郵便で届くまで何営業日かかるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire how to set up online banking mobile app credentials
tasks.hint: Ask banker for steps to register online banking password.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about setting up mobile banking credentials.

Japanese.goal: ネットバンキングのアプリのログイン情報の設定方法を尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ネットバンキングのパスワードを登録する手順を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm branch routing number and personal account number
tasks.hint: Ask banker for printed sheet with routing and account numbers.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified routing and account number details.

Japanese.goal: 支店の金融機関コードと自分の口座番号を確認する
Japanese.hint: 金融機関コードと口座番号を印刷した紙をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Request printed fee schedule document detailing maintenance charges
tasks.hint: Ask for written terms of service and fee guide.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed fee schedule document.

Japanese.goal: 口座維持手数料などが書かれた手数料一覧を印刷してもらう
Japanese.hint: 利用規約と手数料の案内を書面でお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Verify initial cash deposit receipt printed by teller
tasks.hint: Confirm deposit voucher matches cash handed to teller.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified initial deposit receipt accuracy.

Japanese.goal: 窓口で印刷された最初の現金預け入れの控えを確認する
Japanese.hint: 預入票の金額が窓口で渡した現金と合っているか確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm location of nearest surcharge-free branch ATM
tasks.hint: Ask where fee-free cash withdrawals can be made locally.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for location of nearby surcharge-free ATMs.

Japanese.goal: 手数料のかからない一番近い支店のATMの場所を確認する
Japanese.hint: 近くで手数料なしで現金を引き出せる場所を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'overdraft'
tasks.hint: Overdraft occurs when account balance goes below zero. Ask about overdraft protection terms.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'overdraft'.

Japanese.goal: 「当座貸越」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 当座貸越は、残高がマイナスになることです。当座貸越の保護サービスの条件を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'beneficiary'
tasks.hint: Beneficiary inherits account funds. Ask how to designate account beneficiary.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'beneficiary'.

Japanese.goal: 「受取人」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 受取人は、口座のお金を受け継ぐ人です。口座の受取人を指定する方法を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'yield'
tasks.hint: Yield is annual interest earned. Ask about annual percentage yield on savings.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'yield'.

Japanese.goal: 「利回り」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 利回りは、1年間につく利息の割合です。貯蓄預金の年間利回りを聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'remittance'
tasks.hint: Remittance refers to sending money abroad. Ask about international remittance fees.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'remittance'.

Japanese.goal: 「送金」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 送金は、海外などにお金を送ることです。海外送金の手数料を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire whether student account waives monthly service fees
tasks.hint: Ask if full-time student status eliminates account maintenance fee.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about student fee waiver eligibility.

Japanese.goal: 学生口座なら毎月の手数料が免除されるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 全日制の学生なら口座維持手数料がかからないか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about daily debit card ATM cash withdrawal limits
tasks.hint: Inquire how much cash can be withdrawn at ATM per day.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about daily ATM cash withdrawal limit.

Japanese.goal: デビットカードでATMから1日に引き出せる現金の上限について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ATMで1日にいくらまで引き出せるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Report discrepancy in interest rate quote on printed brochure
tasks.hint: Point out conflicting interest rate figures on promotional card.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported interest rate discrepancy on brochure.

Japanese.goal: パンフレットに書かれた金利が説明と違うことを伝える
Japanese.hint: 宣伝用のカードに書かれた金利の数字が食い違っていることを指摘しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request assistance setting up direct deposit from employer paycheck
tasks.hint: Ask banker for direct deposit authorization form.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested direct deposit setup instructions.
tasks.scene_hint: Quiet click of computer keyboard behind glass teller barrier partition.

Japanese.goal: 勤務先からの給与振込の設定を手伝ってもらう
Japanese.hint: 給与振込の申込書をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for clarification regarding wire transfer incoming fee charges
tasks.hint: Inquire if receiving incoming domestic wire incurs service fee.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about incoming wire transfer fee details.

Japanese.goal: 送金を受け取るときの手数料について詳しく尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 国内からの送金を受け取ると手数料がかかるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if joint account requires both account holders present
tasks.hint: Ask if co-signer must be physically present in branch.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about joint account signature requirements.

Japanese.goal: 共同口座を作るには名義人が二人とも来店する必要があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: もう一人の名義人も支店に来なければならないか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Report issue with signature capture pad at banker desk
tasks.hint: Inform banker that digital signature screen is frozen.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported signature capture device malfunction.
tasks.scene_hint: Polished mahogany desk holding pen stand and acrylic brochure holder.

Japanese.goal: 窓口の署名用パッドの不具合を伝える
Japanese.hint: 電子署名の画面が固まっていることを銀行員に伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if paper monthly statements incur additional paper fee
tasks.hint: Inquire if switching to electronic e-statements saves money.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if physical paper statements carry monthly fee.

Japanese.goal: 紙の月次明細に別料金がかかるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 電子明細に切り替えれば節約になるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request temporary debit card printed in branch today
tasks.hint: Ask if instant-issue debit card can be printed immediately.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested instant-issue debit card in branch.

Japanese.goal: 今日支店で仮のデビットカードを発行してもらう
Japanese.hint: その場でデビットカードを発行してもらえるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about automatic savings transfer rules between accounts
tasks.hint: Ask how to schedule recurring monthly transfers to savings.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about automated recurring savings transfers.

Japanese.goal: 口座間の自動積立振替のルールについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 毎月、貯蓄預金へ自動で振り替える設定の方法を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for instructions on activating contactless mobile wallet pay
tasks.hint: Ask banker how to add debit card to Apple or Google Pay.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how to enable mobile wallet payments.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft chime rings as vault door clicks shut in secured back room.

Japanese.goal: スマホのタッチ決済を使えるようにする方法を尋ねる
Japanese.hint: デビットカードをアップルペイやグーグルペイに追加する方法を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify policy regarding inactive dormant account fees
tasks.hint: Ask after how many months of inactivity fees are charged.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about dormant account inactivity fee policy.

Japanese.goal: 使っていない休眠口座の手数料について規定を確認する
Japanese.hint: 何か月使わないと手数料がかかるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if foreign currency exchange is offered at teller window
tasks.hint: Ask if travel currency can be ordered at branch.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about foreign currency exchange service.

Japanese.goal: 窓口で外貨の両替ができるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 旅行用の外貨を支店で注文できるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if certificate of deposit terms offer fixed interest rate
tasks.hint: Inquire about CD duration terms and early withdrawal penalty.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about certificate of deposit interest terms.

Japanese.goal: 定期預金の金利が固定かどうか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 定期預金の期間と、途中で解約したときのペナルティについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request assistance setting up fraud alert text notifications
tasks.hint: Ask banker to turn on instant debit transaction alerts.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested setup of transaction fraud alerts.
tasks.scene_hint: Polished marble floor reflects brass railing surrounding waiting lounge.

Japanese.goal: 不正利用を知らせるショートメッセージ通知の設定を手伝ってもらう
Japanese.hint: デビットカードを使ったらすぐ通知が来るよう設定をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about business checking account requirements for small firm
tasks.hint: Ask what tax documents are needed to open business account.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about small business account opening requirements.

Japanese.goal: 小さな会社の法人用当座預金口座を作る条件について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 法人口座を開くのにどんな税務書類が必要か聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Report misspelled middle name on printed signature card
tasks.hint: Point out typographical error on official account agreement.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported name typo on signature card.

Japanese.goal: 印刷された署名カードのミドルネームのつづりが間違っていることを伝える
Japanese.hint: 正式な口座の契約書類にある誤字を指摘しましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm whether checkbook order includes pre-printed deposit slips
tasks.hint: Ask how many checkbooks are included in starter pack.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified checkbook order contents and pricing.
tasks.scene_hint: Heavy glass entrance doors filter afternoon sunlight onto leather chairs.

Japanese.goal: 注文した小切手帳に記入済みの入金票が含まれているか確認する
Japanese.hint: 最初にもらえるセットに小切手帳が何冊入っているか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if branch provides complimentary notary public services
tasks.hint: Inquire if account holders receive free document notarization.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about notary public service availability.

Japanese.goal: 支店で無料の公証サービスを受けられるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 口座を持っている人は書類の公証を無料で受けられるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request limit increase for daily online bank transfer amount
tasks.hint: Ask banker to increase daily electronic transfer threshold.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested higher daily online transfer limit.

Japanese.goal: ネットバンキングの1日の振込限度額を上げてもらう
Japanese.hint: 1日に振り込める金額の上限を上げてもらえるよう頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about safety deposit box availability and annual rental cost
tasks.hint: Ask what sizes of safe deposit boxes are currently open.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about safe deposit box availability and rates.

Japanese.goal: 貸金庫の空き状況と年間の利用料について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 今どのサイズの貸金庫が空いているか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if early account closure fee applies within first 90 days
tasks.hint: Inquire if closing account within three months incurs penalty.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about early account closure fee terms.

Japanese.goal: 開設から90日以内に解約すると手数料がかかるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 3か月以内に口座を閉じるとペナルティがあるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Report non-receipt of welcome email with online banking link
tasks.hint: Inform banker that registration link email has not arrived.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported missing registration email link.
tasks.scene_hint: Low hum of bill counting machine rapidly sorting paper banknotes.

Japanese.goal: ネットバンキングのリンクが入った案内メールが届いていないことを伝える
Japanese.hint: 登録用のリンクが書かれたメールがまだ届いていないことを伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for recommendation on credit card with travel reward points
tasks.hint: Inquire which bank credit card offers best cashback perks.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for credit card product recommendations.

Japanese.goal: 旅行のポイントがたまるおすすめのクレジットカードを尋ねる
Japanese.hint: この銀行のクレジットカードで一番キャッシュバックの特典がいいものを聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request branch manager assistance for complex trust account
tasks.hint: Ask to speak with branch manager regarding family trust.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested consultation with branch manager.
tasks.scene_hint: Digital exchange rate display board glows green near teller windows.

Japanese.goal: 複雑な信託口座について支店長に対応してもらうようお願いする
Japanese.hint: 家族信託について支店長と話したいと伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm whether overdraft protection pulls funds from savings automatically
tasks.hint: Ask if linked savings account covers negative checking balance.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed how linked overdraft protection operates.

Japanese.goal: 当座貸越の保護サービスで貯蓄預金から自動的にお金が引き落とされるか確認する
Japanese.hint: 残高がマイナスになったとき、つないだ貯蓄預金で補ってくれるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if account opening bonus promotion requires minimum debit transactions
tasks.hint: Inquire about terms for earning new customer sign-up bonus.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about requirements for account opening promotion.

Japanese.goal: 口座開設キャンペーンの特典に最低限のデビット利用回数が必要か尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 新規のお客さん向けの特典をもらう条件を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about policy on depositing foreign currency checks
tasks.hint: Ask processing timeframe and clearing fees for overseas checks.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about foreign check deposit clearing policy.

Japanese.goal: 外貨建ての小切手を入金する際の規定について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 海外の小切手の処理にかかる日数と手数料を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Report forgotten PIN code for existing debit card
tasks.hint: Inform banker of need to reset debit card security PIN.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported forgotten PIN and asked for reset.
tasks.scene_hint: Velvet rope stanchions organize customer queue leading to teller line.

Japanese.goal: 今使っているデビットカードの暗証番号を忘れたことを伝える
Japanese.hint: デビットカードの暗証番号を再設定したいと伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if mobile check deposit feature has daily dollar limit
tasks.hint: Inquire how much can be deposited by taking photo of check.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about mobile check deposit limit.

Japanese.goal: スマホでの小切手入金に1日の金額の上限があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 小切手を写真に撮って入金できるのはいくらまでか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about mortgage loan pre-qualification consultation
tasks.hint: Ask if loan officer is available to discuss home purchase loans.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about mortgage loan pre-qualification options.

Japanese.goal: 住宅ローンの事前審査の相談について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 家を買うためのローンについて、担当者と話せるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request extra set of paper deposit envelopes for ATM use
tasks.hint: Ask teller for bundle of cash deposit envelopes.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested extra deposit envelopes for ATM.
tasks.scene_hint: Laser printer warm paper scent drifts from office desk area.

Japanese.goal: ATM用の紙の入金封筒を追加でもらう
Japanese.hint: 現金の入金用封筒をまとめてもらえるよう窓口の人に頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about policy on disputing unauthorized debit card charges
tasks.hint: Inquire how long fraud investigation takes for unauthorized charges.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about debit card fraud dispute procedures.

Japanese.goal: 身に覚えのないデビットカードの請求に異議を申し立てる手続きについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 不正利用の調査にどのくらいかかるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify procedure for adding power of attorney authorization
tasks.hint: Ask what legal documents are required to grant account access.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about power of attorney authorization steps.

Japanese.goal: 委任状で代理人を追加する手続きを確認する
Japanese.hint: 口座を使う権限を与えるのにどんな法的書類が必要か聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about wealth management advisor consultations
tasks.hint: Ask if financial planning services are available for account holders.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about wealth management advisor consultations.

Japanese.goal: 資産運用アドバイザーへの相談について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 口座を持っている人がファイナンシャルプランニングのサービスを受けられるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Report damaged magnetic stripe on debit card
tasks.hint: Point out physical scratch preventing card swipe reader working.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported damaged debit card magnetic stripe.
tasks.scene_hint: Subdued tones of classical music play softly in executive conference room.

Japanese.goal: デビットカードの磁気ストライプが傷ついていることを伝える
Japanese.hint: 傷のせいでカードが読み取り機で使えないことを指摘しましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if overdraft fees can be waived for first accidental overdraft
tasks.hint: Politely request fee waiver for initial negative balance occurrence.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for courtesy waiver of overdraft fee.

Japanese.goal: 初めてうっかり残高不足になった場合の手数料を免除してもらえるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 初めて残高がマイナスになったときの手数料を免除してもらえるよう、丁寧にお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Request printed bank confirmation letter for visa application
tasks.hint: Ask banker for official stamped account verification letter.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested official bank proof of account letter.

Japanese.goal: ビザ申請用に銀行の口座証明書を印刷してもらう
Japanese.hint: 正式な印が押された口座の証明書をお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about peer-to-peer instant money transfer integration
tasks.hint: Ask if account connects directly to Zelle or Venmo payment apps.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about instant peer-to-peer app integration.
tasks.scene_hint: Brushed steel private consultation booths line perimeter of bank floor.

Japanese.goal: 個人間の即時送金サービスとの連携について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 口座をゼルやベンモなどの送金アプリと直接つなげられるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if interest rates on savings account are variable or fixed
tasks.hint: Inquire if APY changes with central bank rate adjustments.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked whether savings interest rate is variable.

Japanese.goal: 貯蓄預金の金利が変動か固定か尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 中央銀行の金利変更に合わせて年利回りが変わるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request help unlocking online banking account after incorrect password attempts
tasks.hint: Ask banker to reset locked online account access.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested online banking account unlock assistance.

Japanese.goal: パスワードを何度も間違えてロックされたネットバンキングの解除を手伝ってもらう
Japanese.hint: ロックされたネットバンキングを使えるように再設定してもらいましょう。
